acceptance: A second develop merge on a recorded head merges develop.
One shared cache-root helper is used by the answers cache and the TPC-DI tools.
description:
## Problem
1. `make batch-advance REASON=develop-merge` on an integration head already logged as a develop merge (scripts/batch_integration.py `_resolve_advance`) replays the old record instead of merging develop again: entry is found for HEAD with kind == reason, so `_merge_develop` is never called. Seen on batch tpcdi-source when develop gained a commit after a recorded develop merge; the workaround was running the same `git merge --no-ff -m "Merge develop into <branch>" refs/remotes/origin/develop` by hand, then batch-advance.
2. benchbox/core/tpcdi/tools.py finds its cache root as `get_cache_dir().parent`, where get_cache_dir (benchbox/core/expected_results/download.py) is the answers cache. There is no shared BenchBox cache-root helper.

## Change
1. When HEAD equals the recorded integration head and origin/develop is not an ancestor of HEAD, merge develop rather than replay; replay only when the recorded entry is not yet acknowledged. Add a regression test.
2. Add one cache-root helper (XDG_CACHE_HOME or ~/.cache, then benchbox), make get_cache_dir and the TPC-DI tools resolver use it.

## Verification rubric
Pass: a test reproduces the second develop merge and records a new head; tools and answers caches resolve to the same paths as before.
